item.title: Tooi Tooi, Yakusoku -Tune of Memories-
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Eilis
  • 発売日: 2010-12-31
  • スコア: 6.21/10 (5 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 遠い遠い、約束 -Tune of memories-
  • 英語名: Tooi Tooi, Yakusoku -Tune of Memories-

あらすじ

It’s been 2 months since Gen’s close friend Kotone passed away from sickness. All that’s left from her is a letter asking him to go treasure hunting together. Along with it was an old map. Since it is his final promise with her, he sets out on this journey to find something precious.
